name: Grilled Chicken Salad with Goat Cheese, Fresh Raspberries & Pecans
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
instructions: Wash and dry mixed greens and raspberries. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)

Pat chicken dry with paper towels and place on a cutting board. Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, coat the bottom with oil. Add chicken to the pan and grill, turning once, until cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper in a large bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
Using a clean cutting board, roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Remove chicken to a cutting board and cut into strips.
Add chicken, mixed greens, and raspberries to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls, crumble goat cheese over top, and enjoy!
author: Mealime
